text: Grateful means thankful. You feel it when someone is kind to you. The teacher is thankful that Sophia gave books to her students.
A donation is a gift you give for free to help someone. Here, friends give books to Sophia.
To expand means to grow bigger. Sophia wants her book program to reach more kids.
Sophia is a 13-year-old girl from New Jersey. She loves books and shares them with other kids.
New Jersey is a state on the east coast of the United States.
A basement is a room in a house that is under the ground floor.
This means in tidy order, so things are easy to find.
A library is a place full of books. This one is in a basement at home, so it feels hidden.
This is the name of the program Sophia started. It gives books to kids for free.
A program is a plan or project that does a special job over time.
Initial means first. Her first goal was what she hoped to do at the start.
Kids in need are kids who do not have enough of something they need or want, like books.
TIME for Kids is a magazine and website with news stories for kids.
A seventh grader is a student in the seventh year of school, about age 12 or 13.

t: Gloria Barron Prize for Young Heroes
forms: Gloria Barron Prize for Young Heroes
text: This is a big award. It goes to young people who help others or the world.
Awarded means given as a prize.
This means doing something that makes things better for other people.
To request means to ask for something politely.
To scan means to look over something carefully, from one end to the other.
A perfect match is the right book for the right child.
Your interests are the things you like to do or learn about.
Here, being into something means liking it a lot.
To connect to a book means to feel it is about you or things you care about.
Pennsylvania is a state in the United States.
Arizona is a hot, dry state in the southwest of the United States.
New York is a state in the northeast of the United States.
Siblings are brothers and sisters.
Obsessed means you love something so much that you think about it all the time.
To mail something means to send it through the post office.
Linden is a city in New Jersey.
She is a teacher whose students got books from Sophia.
An opportunity is a chance to do something good.
This is the work of making books and sending them to readers.
She is a writer who wrote the Magic Tree House books.
This is a series of adventure books about a brother and sister who travel in a magic tree house.
A series is a group of books that go together, like a story told in many parts.
A publisher is a company that makes books and sends them to readers.
Multiple means more than one. Copies are books that are exactly the same.
She lives across the street from Sophia and helps by giving books.
A bilingual book is written in two languages.
Diverse means different. These are story people who come from many kinds of backgrounds.
Here, to ship means to send by mail or truck.
Literacy is being able to read and write.
Your community is the people and places around where you live.
To inspire means to give someone the wish to do something good.
